core_obligations: By the perfect-module lemma the perfect A-module M admits a finite resolution F by finite projective A-modules (proof lines 19042-19044). Since A -> B is flat, tensoring preserves exactness, so F tensor_A B is a finite-length resolution of M tensor_A B by finite projective B-modules (proof lines 19044-19047). A module with such a resolution is perfect over B, which proves the claim (proof lines 19047-19047).
proof_roadmap: Take the finite projective resolution of M (proof lines 19042-19044).
Base change the resolution along the flat map and conclude perfectness (proof lines 19044-19047).
